 05.06.2025 C-528 No. 749 of 2025
 Hon'ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Ms. Pushpa Joshi, Senior Counsel assisted by Ms. Chetna Latwal, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned A.G.A. for the State.
3. Present petition is filed under Section 528 B.N.S.S. to quash the impugned chargesheet,
summoning/cognizance order dated 04.04.2025 passed by learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Nainital in Criminal Case No. 350 of 2025 under Sections 376, 504 & 506 I.P.C. as well as the entire proceedings of the aforesaid criminal case.

4. Learned senior counsel for the petitioner/accused would submit the petitioner/accused and respondent No.2/complainant are employed in the same department and were merely neighbours;
that, respondent No.2/complainant was experiencing matrimonial disputes with her husband and the petitioner in good faith and without any ill intention extended help to her from time to time.

She would further that however after obtained divorce from her husband respondent No.2/complaint allegedly proposed marriage to the petitioner but the petitioner having no such intent or relationship in mind declined the said proposal and being aggrieved by this refusal

,
respondent No.2/complainant has lodged a false and malicious FIR against the petitioner, therefore,
entire criminal proceedings are liable be quashed.

5. Issue notice to respondent no.2 through ordinary process and registered post acknowledgment due as well as through e-mail and whatsapp, if available.
6. Steps to be taken within three weeks.
7.

List this case after service of notice upon respondent no.2.
C528/749/2025 on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50449415/

1 8. Till the next date of listing, further proceedings of Criminal Case No. 350 of 2025 under 'State Vs.
Naresh Chandra Pant Sections 376, 504 & 506 I.P.C. pending in court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Nainital shall remain stayed.
